subject: C4 compositor variant review: missing selectors + fatal-nil list
body:
C4 (175a718) compositor-variant review, read-only. QuartzCore 16.7 call sites vs Tegu sources (no hard proof of runtime reachability).
BLOCKERS, ranked:
1) Missing selectors (unrecognized-selector abort): TeguTexture has no newTextureViewWithPixelFormat: (CA 0x1882e5264, 0x188357668: colour/sRGB views, image upload path); compute encoder has no setThreadgroupMemoryLength:atIndex: (CA 0x1884809fc/0x188480a7c, APL kernels); TeguBuffer lacks newLinearTextureWithDescriptor:offset:bytesPerRow:bytesPerImage: and device lacks newBufferWithBytesNoCopy:... (CA 0x1884843f4/0x18848438c) - currently unreachable only because deviceLinearReadOnlyTextureAlignmentBytes=0 (device_limits.h) makes CA skip zero-copy (udiv by 0 at 0x188484304); any non-zero alignment enables the crash. newResourceGroupFromResources/encodeCacheHint absent (env gated).
2) Compute pipelines: CA treats nil as fatal (0x188482fcc/0x18848300c/0x18848305c) for compute_apl, compute_apl_fast, sum_apl_and_compute_dimming_factor; inert covers render only. runtime_pipeline.inc:44,47,79,88,95,101-153; maxThreadgroupMemoryLength returns 0 (compute_frontend.m:964). Reachable only if display reports APL dimming (unverified).
3) Function specialization nil is fatal: library_frontend.inc:311 (constants) and :315 (descriptor options!=0). default.metallib load nil is fatal: library_frontend.inc:117-120,137,145. Need host test through newLibraryWithURL on the real 1,014,944 B file and CA-shaped MTLFunctionDescriptor.
4) Render PSO nil remains before inert scope: render_pipeline.inc:1074,1076 (non-TeguFunction), :1888 requires COMPOSITOR+GENERIC_JOB caps, :2021 (alloc). Inert block :1997 otherwise good.
5) Texture/device nils tolerated by CA but starve content: newTextureWithDescriptor formats only 1,10,30,70,80,115,ASTC (render_encoder.inc ~613); IOSurface import BGRA8 only, <=16 MB (render_encoder.inc:706-730); newBufferWithLength options!=0 nil (compute_frontend.m:1028; CA heap buffer 0x188482b20 uses 0x20). Residual nil encoder render_encoder.inc ~3357; commandBuffer nil after submissionFailed.
(2) Inert pipeline: draws dropped, command not invalidated, jobs still run, handlers fire (teguExecute status 3->scheduled->4/5); CA uses its own CA::Fence, no MTLFence/Event/SharedEvent - no hang path found. Backdrop/blur outputs simply undefined.
(3) supportsFeatureSet mapping matches enum (F1=0,2,5,8,12; F2=1,3,6,9,13); derived queries (tile shaders, memoryless, FP16, SIMD, raster order, YCBCR) stay false from empty profile - conservative, consistent enough. maxColorAttachments=4 makes CA use 3 attachments.
(4) Safe build differs from C3 beyond flags: maxColorAttachments 2->4 and supportsFeatureSet true for Apple1/2 are process-wide (SpringBoard/chronod/MPS); nord2_render_pass.inc dropped the same-texture-twice guard (silent double write).
